answer.reason: LEV 10:4-5 tells a deed of Elzaphan, carrying Nadab and Abihu out of the camp, which the summary does not state; the other verses only list him or his descendants.

clauses.english: carried Nadab and Abihu out of the camp at Moses' command after the fire of the LORD killed them
clauses.quote: carried them in their coats out of the camp

doubts: The verses LEV 10:4-5 do not name Nadab and Abihu directly; they are 'your brethren' and 'them' after LEV 10:2, and the clause assumes this reading.
EXO 6:22 and NUM 3:30 were left out because they only give his family and the summary already covers them; 1CH 15:8 and 2CH 29:13 mention his descendants, not him.
